name: io.github.dooolmang/kkuldogu-korea-payroll
title: Korea Payroll & Tax (kkuldogu)
description: South Korea 2026 payroll, tax & law: 69 calculators from net pay to gift tax and inheritance.

tools.name: net_pay
tools.description: South Korea take-home pay for an employee: monthly net salary after national pension, health and long-term care insurance, employment insurance, and withheld income tax (2026 NTS simplified withholding table) plus local income tax.

nonTaxable.description: Monthly non-taxable allowances, e.g. meal allowance; default 200000 (KRW)

dependents.description: Dependents for withholding, including self; default 1

severanceIncluded.description: Annual salary includes severance (divided by 13); default false

tools.name: social_insurance
tools.description: South Korea four major social insurances (national pension, health, long-term care, employment) for a monthly wage: employee deductions and employer contributions at 2026 rates.

employerSize.description: Employer headcount bracket for the employer employment-insurance rate; default under150

tools.name: severance_pay
tools.description: South Korea statutory severance pay (toejikgeum): 30 days of average wage per year of service, with retirement income tax, from hire date, last working day and last 3 months of pay. Pass monthlyOrdinaryWage to apply the legal rule that the ordinary wage replaces a lower average wage (Labor Standards Act art. 2(2)); without it only the average wage is used. Rounding follows the Ministry of Employment and Labor severance calculator.

monthlyPay.description: Average monthly pay for the last 3 months (KRW)

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

annualLeavePay.description: Annual-leave allowance paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage (base pay + fixed allowances). If its daily amount (÷209×8) exceeds the daily average wage, severance is computed from it (KRW)

tools.name: retirement_income_tax
tools.description: South Korea retirement income tax on a severance payment: service-year deduction, converted-pay deduction, national and local tax, and the reduced tax if received as an IRP pension.

tools.name: annual_leave
tools.description: South Korea paid annual leave under the Labor Standards Act: days currently available, remaining days, next accrual, and payout value of unused leave.

basis.description: Accrual basis: hire-date anniversary or calendar (fiscal) year; default hire

usedDays.description: Leave days already used in the current period

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage, for the payout value (KRW)

tools.name: unemployment_benefit
tools.description: South Korea unemployment benefit (job-seeking allowance, silup geupyeo): daily amount with 2026 cap and floor, number of benefit days, and total.

monthlyPay.description: Average monthly pay for the last 3 months (KRW)

dailyContractHours.description: Contracted hours per day, for the floor; default 8

tools.name: parental_leave_benefit
tools.description: South Korea parental leave benefit from employment insurance, month by month with caps, including the 6+6 both-parents scheme and single parents.

mode.description: normal, both_parents (6+6 scheme, child under 18 months) or single_parent; default normal

spouseMonthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Spouse's monthly ordinary wage, both_parents only (KRW)

spouseMonths.description: Spouse leave months, both_parents only; default 6

tools.name: weekly_holiday_pay
tools.description: South Korea weekly holiday pay (juhyu sudang): the paid weekly rest allowance owed to workers contracted for 15+ hours a week, with weekly and monthly pay including it.

tools.name: wage_conversion
tools.description: Convert between hourly wage, monthly salary and annual salary the South Korean way (monthly hours include paid weekly holiday hours, 209 for a 40-hour week), with a 2026 minimum wage check.

amount.description: Wage amount in the given unit (KRW)

tools.name: minimum_wage_check
tools.description: Check a South Korean monthly wage against the 2026 minimum wage (KRW 10,320/hour): counts base pay, monthly regular bonus and cash welfare allowances, supports the 90% probation rate.

monthlyWelfare.description: Monthly cash welfare allowances such as meals or transport (KRW)

probation.description: Probation within first 3 months of a 1+ year contract (90% rate); default false

tools.name: part_time_pay
tools.description: South Korea part-time (alba) monthly pay from an hourly wage and schedule, including weekly holiday pay, after either 3.3% withholding or the four social insurances plus income tax.

deduction.description: none, freelancer_3_3 (3.3% withholding) or social_insurance (four insurances + income tax); default none

tools.name: overtime_pay
tools.description: South Korea overtime, night and holiday work premiums under the Labor Standards Act (1.5x overtime, +0.5x night, 1.5x/2x holiday); workplaces with fewer than 5 employees get no premium.

wage.description: Hourly wage, or monthly ordinary wage when unit is monthly (KRW)

unit.description: hourly, or monthly (divided by 209 hours); default hourly

nightHours.description: Night hours (22:00-06:00); also enter them as overtime if they overlap

holidayHours.description: Holiday work hours up to 8 per day

holidayHoursOver8.description: Holiday work hours beyond 8 per day

fiveOrMoreEmployees.description: Workplace has 5 or more employees; default true

tools.name: ordinary_wage
tools.description: South Korea ordinary wage (tongsang imgeum): hourly and daily ordinary wage from base pay, fixed allowances and regular bonuses, the basis for overtime, unused leave and dismissal notice pay.

monthlyFixedAllowances.description: Fixed monthly allowances paid to everyone regularly (KRW)

tools.name: average_wage
tools.description: South Korea average wage (pyeonggyun imgeum): daily average over the 3 months before the last working day, the basis for severance pay and unemployment benefit; falls back to the ordinary wage when that is higher.

monthlyPay.description: Monthly pay over the last 3 months (KRW)

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage (base pay + fixed allowances). If its daily amount (÷209×8) exceeds the daily average wage, it is used as the average wage (KRW)

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

annualLeavePay.description: Annual-leave allowance paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

tools.name: gross_from_net
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/gross-from-net with x402.] Reverse South Korea take-home pay: the gross monthly and annual salary needed to reach a target monthly net pay after 2026 social insurance and withheld income tax.

severanceIncluded.description: Quote the annual salary with severance included (x13); default false

tools.name: freelancer_withholding
tools.description: South Korea 3.3% business-income withholding for freelancers (3% income tax + 0.3% local tax), in either direction: net from gross, or the gross to invoice for a target net.

amount.description: Gross payment, or desired net when direction is net_to_gross (KRW)

tools.name: daily_worker_tax
tools.description: South Korea daily (day-labor) worker tax: income tax after the KRW 150,000 daily deduction and 55% credit, local tax and employment insurance, for wages paid daily or in one lump sum.

paidDaily.description: Paid each day (true) or in one lump sum (false); default true

tools.name: other_income_tax
tools.description: South Korea other-income (gita sodeuk) withholding of 22% on income after deemed expenses, e.g. lecture fees, manuscript fees and prizes, with the KRW 50,000 exemption threshold.

expenseRate.description: Deemed expense rate: 0.6 (lectures, manuscripts, advisory), 0.8 (public-interest prizes) or 0; default 0.6

tools.name: dismissal_notice_pay
tools.description: South Korea dismissal notice allowance: 30 days of ordinary wage owed when an employer gives less than 30 days notice (not owed for under 3 months of service).

dismissalDate.description: Dismissal date (day after the last working day) (YYYY-MM-DD)

under3Months.description: Employed for less than 3 months; default false

tools.name: shutdown_allowance
tools.description: South Korea business shutdown allowance (hyueop sudang): 70% of average wage, or the ordinary wage if that is lower, for days the employer suspends work (5+ employee workplaces).

fiveOrMoreEmployees.description: Workplace has 5 or more employees; default true

tools.name: maternity_leave_pay
tools.description: South Korea maternity leave pay for 90 days (120 for multiple births): split between employer and employment insurance, with the 2026 monthly cap of KRW 2.2 million.

multipleBirth.description: Twins or more (120 days); default false

priorityCompany.description: Employer is a priority-support (small/medium) company; default true

tools.name: paternity_leave_pay
tools.description: South Korea spouse (paternity) childbirth leave pay for the 20 paid days, and how much employment insurance covers at priority-support companies.

priorityCompany.description: Employer is a priority-support (small/medium) company; default true

tools.name: reduced_hours_childcare_benefit
tools.description: South Korea reduced working hours for childcare benefit: monthly employment-insurance top-up (first 10 reduced hours at 100%, rest at 80%, with caps) plus the reduced employer pay.

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage before the reduction (KRW)

months.description: Months of reduced hours, for the total; default 1

tools.name: year_end_tax_settlement
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/year-end-tax-settlement with x402.] South Korea year-end tax settlement (yeonmal jeongsan) estimate for employees: refund or additional tax from gross salary, dependents, card spending and the main deductions and credits, choosing itemized vs standard credit. 2026 income rules (settled in January 2027), including the child-count card limits, the age-9 child credit and the 40% hometown-love donation band.

grossSalary.description: Annual gross salary excluding non-taxable pay (KRW)

taxWithheld.description: Income tax already withheld this year; estimated from the withholding table if omitted (KRW)

dependents.description: Persons for the basic deduction, including self; default 1

children8to20.description: Children eligible for the child tax credit: aged 9 or older for 2026 income (8 or older for 2025; the age rises one year each year to 13 by 2030)

birthOrder.description: Birth/adoption this year: 0 none, 1 first, 2 second, 3 third or later

traditionalMarketTransit.description: Traditional market and public transport spending (KRW)

cultureSports.description: Books, performances, cinema, gym spending (salary up to 70M) (KRW)

hometownDonation.description: Hometown-love (gohyang sarang) donations by the employee, up to 20M: 100/110 credit up to 100,000, 40% up to 200,000, 15% above; allowed with the standard credit (KRW)

annualRent.description: Monthly rent paid over the year (homeless householder) (KRW)

tools.name: monthly_rent_tax_credit
tools.description: South Korea monthly rent (wolse) tax credit at year-end settlement: 17% or 15% of up to KRW 10 million rent for homeless tenants earning up to KRW 80 million.

eligibleTenant.description: Homeless householder (or member) with resident registration at the address; default true

tools.name: card_income_deduction
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/card-income-deduction with x402.] South Korea credit card income deduction for year-end settlement: deduction from credit, debit/cash, traditional market/transit and culture spending above 25% of salary, with limits and estimated tax saved.

traditionalMarketTransit.description: Traditional market and public transport spending (KRW)

tools.name: pension_savings_tax_credit
tools.description: South Korea pension savings and IRP tax credit: 16.5% or 13.2% (incl. local tax) of contributions up to KRW 9 million, and the extra refund from filling the remaining limit.

tools.name: bonus_tax
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/bonus-tax with x402.] South Korea tax withheld on a bonus or incentive payment: income tax by the simplified-table bonus method over the payment period, local tax and employment insurance, and the net bonus.

periodMonths.description: Months the bonus covers (1, 3 quarterly, 6 half-year, 12 annual); default 1

tools.name: vat
tools.description: South Korea 10% VAT: split a VAT-inclusive total into supply amount and VAT, or add VAT to a supply amount, with Korean rounding.

amount.description: Supply amount, or VAT-inclusive total when mode is total (KRW)

mode.description: amount is the supply amount (default) or the VAT-inclusive total

tools.name: brokerage_fee
tools.description: South Korea real-estate brokerage fee ceiling (bokbi) for a sale, jeonse or monthly-rent lease of a house or officetel: statutory rate bracket, fee cap and VAT.

transaction.description: sale, jeonse (lump-sum deposit lease) or wolse (monthly rent); default sale

price.description: Sale price, or deposit for a lease (KRW)

includeVat.description: Add 10% VAT to the fee; default true

tools.name: jeonse_wolse_conversion
tools.description: Convert between South Korean jeonse deposit and monthly rent (wolse) at a conversion rate, with the statutory 4.5% cap check on a landlord's asked rent.

askedMonthlyRent.description: Rent the landlord asks, to compare with the legal cap (KRW)

ratePct.description: Annual conversion rate in percent; default 4.5 (statutory cap)

tools.name: child_benefits
tools.description: South Korea government cash support for a newborn: first-meeting voucher, parent benefit for ages 0-1 and the monthly child allowance up to age 9, with a dated schedule.

firstChild.description: First child (voucher 2M) or later (3M); default true

area.description: Residence, sets the child allowance: capital area 100k, non-capital 105k, depopulation preferred 110k, special 120k per month; default capital

daycare.description: Child attends daycare at ages 0-1 (parent benefit offset by daycare fee); default false

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: South Korea business days: count working days between two dates, or find the date N business days later, skipping weekends and Korean public holidays (2025-2027 table incl. substitute holidays).

mode.description: count days between startDate and endDate (default) or add N business days to startDate

days.description: Business days to add, add mode; default 1

includeStart.description: Count the start date itself, count mode; default true

tools.name: deposit_interest
tools.description: South Korea bank deposit or installment-savings interest after tax: maturity amount with simple or monthly-compounded interest and the 15.4% interest withholding tax (or 9.5% preferential, or tax-free).

kind.description: deposit (lump sum) or savings (fixed monthly installment); default deposit

amount.description: Principal, or monthly installment for savings (KRW)

tools.name: korean_age
tools.description: Korean age calculation: international age (the legal standard in South Korea since June 2023), year age, traditional counting age, zodiac animal, and the next birthday.

tools.name: pyeong_conversion
tools.description: Convert between square meters and pyeong, the Korean real-estate area unit (1 pyeong = 400/121 m2, about 3.3058 m2).

value.description: Area in the unit given by from

tools.name: pregnancy_due_date
tools.description: Pregnancy due date and gestational week from the last menstrual period, with the South Korean labor-law dates that follow: reduced working hours in pregnancy, earliest maternity leave start, and the paternity leave deadline.

lastPeriodDate.description: First day of the last menstrual period (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: service_period
tools.description: Length of service at a South Korean employer from the hire date: years, months, days, next anniversary, annual leave entitlement for the current year of service, and severance pay eligibility.

tools.name: gift_tax
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/gift-tax with x402.] South Korea gift tax (jeungyeose) on a gift received: relationship deduction (spouse 600M, parent to adult child 50M, to minor 20M, other relatives 10M), 10-year aggregation, marriage/childbirth deduction, 10-50% progressive rates, generation-skipping surcharge and the 3% on-time filing credit.

donor.description: Who gives: spouse, lineal_ascendant (parent or grandparent; default), lineal_descendant (child gives to parent), other_relative (within 6th degree by blood / 4th by marriage, incl. son- or daughter-in-law), unrelated

recipientMinor.description: Recipient is a minor (deduction 20M instead of 50M from a lineal ascendant); default false

priorGifts10y.description: Gifts already received from the same donor in the previous 10 years (both parents count as one donor); assumed to have used the same relationship deduction (KRW)

marriageBirthDeduction.description: Marriage/childbirth deduction to claim, lifetime cap 100M combined, lineal_ascendant only (KRW)

generationSkipping.description: Gift from a grandparent to a grandchild while the parent is alive (30% surcharge, 40% for a minor receiving over 2 billion); default false

filedOnTime.description: Filed within 3 months after the end of the gift month (3% credit); default true

tools.name: housing_acquisition_tax
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/housing-acquisition-tax with x402.] South Korea acquisition tax when buying a home: 1-3% by price (sliding rate between 600M and 900M), 8%/12% heavy rates for multiple homes and corporations, plus local education tax and rural special tax, and the first-home relief of up to 2M.

homesAfterPurchase.description: Homes the household owns including this one; default 1

regulatedArea.description: Home is in an adjustment-target area (jojeong daesang jiyeok), where heavy rates start from the 2nd home; default false

corporation.description: Buyer is a corporation (12%); default false

areaOver85sqm.description: Exclusive area over 85 m2 (rural special tax applies); default false

firstHome.description: First home ever for the household, price up to 1.2B (relief up to 2M of acquisition tax; surtax adjustments not modeled); default false

tools.name: vehicle_tax
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/vehicle-tax with x402.] South Korea annual vehicle tax (jadongchase) for a private passenger car: per-cc rate by engine displacement, 30% local education tax, age reduction from the 3rd year (5% a year, up to 50%), flat amount for electric cars, and the 2026 annual-prepayment discount.

displacementCc.description: Engine displacement in cc; not needed for electric

vehicleAgeYears.description: Vehicle age counted from first registration, 1 = first year; default 1

electric.description: Battery electric car (flat 100,000 plus education tax); default false

prepayMonth.description: Month of annual prepayment (1, 3, 6 or 9) for the 5% discount on the remaining period; 0 = no prepayment (default)

tools.name: income_tax_from_tax_base
tools.description: South Korea comprehensive income tax from a tax base (gwase pyojun): the 8-bracket 6-45% progressive table with deduction amounts, plus 10% local income tax, marginal and effective rates.

taxBase.description: Tax base: income after all deductions (KRW)

tools.name: loan_repayment
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/loan-repayment with x402.] Loan repayment schedule summary as used by South Korean banks: equal monthly payment (wolligeum gyundeung), equal principal (wongeum gyundeung) or interest-only with bullet repayment; monthly payment, first and last installments, total interest.

method.description: equal_payment (default), equal_principal, or bullet (interest monthly, principal at maturity)

tools.name: early_repayment_fee
tools.description: South Korea early loan repayment fee (jungdo sanghwan susuryo): repaid amount x fee rate x remaining days / fee period (usually 3 years, after which the fee is waived).

feeRatePct.description: Fee rate in percent from the loan contract, e.g. 1.2

elapsedDays.description: Days since the loan was taken out

feePeriodDays.description: Period during which the fee applies, in days; default 1095 (3 years)

tools.name: inheritance_shares
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/inheritance-shares with x402.] South Korea statutory inheritance shares and forced-heirship reserve (yuryubun) under the Civil Code: heirs by rank (children, then parents, then siblings), the spouse 50% add-on, and reserved portions (1/2 of the share for children and spouse, 1/3 for parents, none for siblings). Representation (daeseup) and heirs beyond siblings are not modeled.

spouse.description: Surviving legally married spouse; default false

children.description: Number of children (lineal descendants of the nearest degree)

parents.description: Number of surviving parents (lineal ascendants of the nearest degree); inherit only if there are no children

siblings.description: Number of siblings; inherit only if there is no spouse, child or parent

tools.name: housing_subscription_score
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/housing-subscription-score with x402.] South Korea housing subscription points (cheongyak gajeom, max 84) for private apartment sales: homeless period (max 32), dependents (max 35) and subscription account period (max 17). The spouse-account bonus is not included.

ownsHome.description: Applicant or spouse owns a home (homeless-period points become 0); default false

homelessYears.description: Years without a home, counted from age 30 or from marriage registration if earlier

dependents.description: Dependents in the household, excluding the applicant

accountYears.description: Years since the subscription savings account was opened

tools.name: litigation_stamp_fee
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/litigation-stamp-fee with x402.] South Korea civil lawsuit filing costs: court stamp fee (injidae) from the claim amount by bracket, 1.5x on appeal and 2x at the Supreme Court, 10% off for electronic filing, plus the prepaid service-of-process fee (songdallyo).

electronic.description: Filed through the electronic litigation system (10% off the stamp fee); default true

parties.description: Number of parties, for the service fee; default 2

tools.name: late_payment_interest
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/late-payment-interest with x402.] South Korea statutory late-payment interest (jiyeon sonhaegeum) on a money debt: 5% civil, 6% commercial, 12% under the litigation-promotion act after a complaint is served, or a contract rate, prorated by day.

customRatePct.description: Annual rate in percent when rate is custom

tools.name: resignation_settlement
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/resignation-settlement with x402.] South Korea resignation settlement in one call: statutory severance pay, retirement income tax and local tax, net severance, unused annual-leave pay, and how much more you get by moving the last working day (one more day, week, month, or until the next annual-leave grant). Uses the ordinary wage when it is higher than the average wage. Optionally adds the unemployment benefit estimate for an involuntary separation.

monthlyPay.description: Average gross monthly pay for the last 3 months (KRW)

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage; defaults to monthlyPay (KRW)

unusedLeaveDays.description: Accrued annual-leave days not yet used; default 0

fiveOrMoreEmployees.description: Workplace has 5+ employees (annual leave rules apply); default true

age.description: Age at separation; with insuredYears, adds the unemployment benefit estimate

tools.name: job_offer_comparison
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/job-offer-comparison with x402.] Compare a South Korean job offer with the current job on what actually matters: annual take-home pay including bonus (after 2026 social insurance and withholding tax), monthly take-home, and real hourly net pay once commuting time is counted. Assumes KRW 200,000 monthly non-taxable pay and 1 dependent.

commuteMinutesPerDay.description: Round-trip commute per working day in minutes; default 0
Round-trip commute per working day in minutes; default 0

tools.name: stock_transaction_tax
tools.description: South Korea securities transaction tax on selling listed shares (2026 rates): KOSPI 0.05% plus 0.15% rural special tax, KOSDAQ 0.20%, charged on the sale amount whether or not there is a gain.

tools.name: rental_income_separate_tax
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/rental-income-separate-tax with x402.] South Korea housing rental income tax under separate taxation (annual rent up to 20 million KRW): 14% on rent minus deemed expenses (50%, or 60% for registered rental housing) and the basic deduction (2M, or 4M registered, only if other income is 20M or less), plus local income tax. Deemed rent on deposits and registered-housing tax reductions are not modeled.

registered.description: Registered rental housing (60% expenses, 4M deduction); default false

otherIncomeOver20M.description: Other comprehensive income amount exceeds 20M (no basic deduction); default false

tools.name: financial_income_tax
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/financial-income-tax with x402.] South Korea comprehensive taxation of financial income (interest and dividends over 20 million KRW a year): compares the comprehensive method (first 20M at 14%, the excess added to other income at 6-45%) with the 14% separate method and takes the larger, then shows tax due beyond what was withheld. Dividend gross-up and the 2026 high-dividend separate-taxation option are not modeled.

financialIncome.description: Total interest and dividend income for the year, before tax (KRW)

otherTaxBase.description: Tax base of other comprehensive income (after deductions), e.g. wage or business income; default 0 (KRW)

tools.name: unemployment_eligibility
tools.description: South Korea unemployment benefit eligibility check: at least 180 insured days in the 18 months before leaving, an involuntary (or justified) reason for leaving, and being able and actively seeking work. Use unemployment-benefit for the amount.

insuredDaysLast18Months.description: Paid days under employment insurance in the 18 months before separation (includes paid weekly holidays)

reason.description: Reason for leaving. voluntary_justified covers quitting for a legally recognized reason such as unpaid wages, workplace harassment or a commute over 3 hours

ableAndSeeking.description: Able to work and actively looking for a job; default true

tools.name: weekly_hours_check
tools.description: South Korea 52-hour workweek check under the Labor Standards Act: 40 standard hours plus at most 12 overtime hours a week (35 plus 5 for workers under 18); workplaces with fewer than 5 employees are exempt for adults.

weeklyHours.description: Hours actually worked in the week

fiveOrMoreEmployees.description: Workplace has 5 or more employees; default true

tools.name: severance_batch
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/severance-batch with x402.] South Korea statutory severance pay for up to 100 employees in one call: per-employee gross severance, retirement income tax and net amount using the same calculation as severance-pay (Ministry of Employment and Labor rounding, optional ordinary-wage comparison), with company-wide totals.

monthlyPay.description: Average monthly pay for the last 3 months (KRW)

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

annualLeavePay.description: Annual-leave allowance paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage, to apply the ordinary-wage comparison (KRW)

tools.name: payroll_batch
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/payroll-batch with x402.] South Korea monthly payroll run for up to 100 employees in one call: per-employee take-home pay with each deduction (national pension, health, long-term care, employment insurance, income tax from the 2026 NTS withholding table, local income tax), employer social-insurance contributions, and company-wide totals including total employer cost. Industrial accident insurance (industry-specific rate) is not included.

employerSize.description: Employer headcount bracket for the employer employment-insurance rate; default under150

tools.name: new_parent_benefits
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/new-parent-benefits with x402.] Everything a South Korean household receives around a birth, in one call: maternity leave pay (90/120 days, who pays what), parental leave benefit month by month (normal, 6+6 both-parents, or single-parent scheme), the spouse's 20-day childbirth leave pay, and government cash support for the child (first-meeting voucher, parent benefit, child allowance to age 9).

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage of the parent taking maternity leave (KRW)

multipleBirth.description: Twins or more (120 days); default false

priorityCompany.description: Employer is a priority-support (SME) company; default true

parentalLeaveMonths.description: Months of parental leave after maternity leave; default 12, 0 for none

parentalLeaveMode.description: normal (default), both_parents (6+6 scheme; needs the spouse fields) or single_parent

spouseMonthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Spouse's monthly ordinary wage; adds the spouse's childbirth leave pay (KRW)

spousePriorityCompany.description: Spouse's employer is a priority-support company; default true

spouseParentalLeaveMonths.description: Months of parental leave the spouse takes; default 0

firstChild.description: First child (voucher KRW 2,000,000; later children 3,000,000); default true

area.description: Residence area for the child allowance amount; default capital

daycare.description: Child attends daycare (parent benefit replaced by the daycare subsidy); default false

tools.name: industrial_accident_leave_benefit
tools.description: South Korea industrial accident (sanjae) temporary disability benefit for days off work: 70% of the average daily wage, capped by the 2026 maximum compensation base, with the low-income rule (90%, then the minimum-wage floor). Not paid when the time off is 3 days or less. Age-based reductions and part-time rules are not modeled.

tools.name: stamp_duty
tools.description: South Korea stamp duty (injise) on a contract document by its stated amount: real-estate ownership transfer contracts and loan agreements, 20,000 to 350,000 KRW, with the exemptions (10M or less; housing transfers up to 100M; loans up to 50M).

document.description: real_estate_transfer (sale contract; default) or loan (money loan agreement)

housing.description: The property is housing (transfers up to 100M are exempt); default false

tools.name: rent_increase_limit
tools.description: South Korea legal cap on rent increases at renewal: 5% for housing leases, and 5% for commercial leases whose converted deposit (deposit + monthly rent x 100) is within the regional threshold (Seoul 900M, overconcentration areas and Busan 690M, other metropolitan cities 540M, elsewhere 370M).

region.description: Region, commercial leases only; default seoul

tools.name: simplified_vat
tools.description: South Korea VAT for a simplified taxpayer (ganigwase): annual sales incl. VAT x industry value-added rate (15-40%) x 10%, minus 0.5% of invoiced purchases and the 1.3% card-sales credit (cap 10M a year, rule for 2026 supplies), no refund. Sales under 48M a year are exempt from payment. Eligibility (prior-year sales under 104M) is only flagged.

annualSales.description: Sales for the tax year including VAT (gonggeup daega) (KRW)

industry.description: Industry: retail, restaurant and recycling 15%; manufacturing, agriculture and parcel delivery 20%; lodging 25%; construction, transport, IT and other services 30%; finance, professional services, facility support/rental and real estate 40%

purchaseInvoiceAmount.description: Purchases incl. VAT backed by tax invoices or card/cash receipts (0.5% credit) (KRW)

cardSales.description: Sales paid by credit card or cash receipt (1.3% credit) (KRW)

tools.name: unpaid_wage_interest
tools.description: South Korea 20% a year statutory interest on unpaid wages (Labor Standards Act art. 37): for wages and lump-sum severance owed at resignation or death, from the day after the 14-day deadline; for regular wages of current employees, from the day after the payday (paydays from 2025-10-23). Not for interim severance settlements (6%/12% per a 2026 Supreme Court ruling); excused delay periods are not modeled.

wageType.description: final_settlement (owed at resignation or death, default) or regular_payday (regular wages while employed)

dueEventDate.description: final_settlement: separation (or death) date; regular_payday: the missed payday (YYYY-MM-DD)

paidDate.description: Payment date, last day counted; default today (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: pension_income_tax
tools.description: South Korea tax on private pension withdrawals (pension savings, IRP: deducted contributions and earnings): withholding 5% under age 70, 4% to 79, 3% from 80 or for lifetime annuities (from 2026), plus 10% local tax. Over 15M a year, compares 15% separate tax with comprehensive taxation (pension deduction, other tax base). Public pensions and deferred severance in an IRP are not modeled.

annualPension.description: Private pension received this year (taxable part) (KRW)

lifetimeAnnuity.description: Paid under a lifetime annuity contract (3%); default false

otherTaxBase.description: Tax base from other comprehensive income, to compare comprehensive taxation when over 15M (KRW)

tools.name: registration_license_tax
tools.description: South Korea registration license tax (deungnok myeonheose) to register a mortgage (on the maximum secured amount, chaegwon choegoaek) or a jeonse right (on the deposit): 0.2% plus 20% local education tax. Housing bond purchases and the Seoul-area heavy rate for corporations are not included.

amount.description: Maximum secured amount for a mortgage, or jeonse deposit (KRW)

tools.name: non_housing_acquisition_tax
tools.description: South Korea acquisition tax on land, shops and other non-housing property: 4% purchase (3% farmland), 3.5% gift, 2.8% inheritance or new construction, plus rural special tax (0.2%) and local education tax ((rate - 2%) x 20%). Totals 4.6%, 3.4%, 4.0%, 3.16%. Inherited farmland, reliefs and heavy rates are not modeled.

price.description: Tax base: purchase price, or market value for a gift or inheritance (KRW)

acquisition.description: How it is acquired; default purchase

tools.name: overseas_stock_capital_gains_tax
tools.description: South Korea capital gains tax on foreign stocks for a resident: gains and losses netted over the year, minus the 2.5M basic deduction (shared with taxable domestic share gains), taxed 20% plus 2% local tax (22%). Enter KRW amounts converted at the exchange rates on the trade dates. The domestic reinvestment (RIA) relief is not modeled.

basicDeductionUsed.description: Basic deduction already used on other share gains this year (KRW)

tools.name: annual_leave_batch
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/annual-leave-batch with x402.] South Korea paid annual leave for up to 100 employees in one call: days available, used and remaining for each employee and the payout value of unused leave, with company-wide totals. Same calculation as annual-leave.

basis.description: Accrual basis: hire-date anniversary or calendar (fiscal) year; default hire

usedDays.description: Leave days already used in the current period

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage, for the payout value (KRW)

referenceDate.description: Date to evaluate for employees that do not give their own; default today (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: year_end_tax_batch
tools.description: [Paid-only, $0.02 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/year-end-tax-batch with x402.] South Korea year-end tax settlement estimate for up to 100 employees in one call: refund or additional tax for each employee from salary, dependents, card spending and the main deductions, with totals. Same calculation as year-end-tax-settlement, without the per-employee breakdown.

grossSalary.description: Annual gross salary excluding non-taxable pay (KRW)

taxWithheld.description: Income tax already withheld this year; estimated from the withholding table if omitted (KRW)

dependents.description: Persons for the basic deduction, including self; default 1

children8to20.description: Children eligible for the child tax credit: aged 9 or older for 2026 income (8 or older for 2025; the age rises one year each year to 13 by 2030)

birthOrder.description: Birth/adoption this year: 0 none, 1 first, 2 second, 3 third or later

traditionalMarketTransit.description: Traditional market and public transport spending (KRW)

cultureSports.description: Books, performances, cinema, gym spending (salary up to 70M) (KRW)

hometownDonation.description: Hometown-love (gohyang sarang) donations by the employee, up to 20M: 100/110 credit up to 100,000, 40% up to 200,000, 15% above; allowed with the standard credit (KRW)

annualRent.description: Monthly rent paid over the year (homeless householder) (KRW)
